notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has a working stack-split flow (shift-click a bag stack opens it; pick a count; Split places the count on the cursor; Cancel/Escape closes; GameMenuUiLaw models its escape layer). But it is a plain ImGui window with a SliderInt, anchored at the mouse, not the vanilla 172x96 UI-MoneyFrame parchment spinner.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The slider-based ImGui window may be a deliberate interaction substitute for the arrow spinner (function is equivalent: choose 1..N and confirm/cancel). Candidate for Nico's ruling on whether the vanilla spinner look is required; the anchoring and art gaps stand regardless.
